items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions DB Chandler as a historical figure ('back in New Orleans'), and the interviewee simply responds 'No.' indicating no personal interaction or specific relationship is discussed.

ctx.x: You know. Do you feel that way about them?

I do -- I won’t take up your time on the oral history. The drum set is probably the most challenging of instruments and it was something that was developed here on this soil by our forefathers because that’s what they had available to them. They had a sound in their head and they wanted to get it out and they just assembled the instrument so they could create it. And that goes back to be DB Chandler, you know back in New Orleans. But any way so unless there is something that I forgot or there is something that…
